run_salina_cl_training: run the Salina-CL training loop with Hydra config for continuous learning scenarios
instantiate_class_from_config: instantiate a class from a Hydra config object using salina instantiate_class
train_framework_with_task: train the framework on a task and log evaluation metrics with the logger
evaluate_framework_tasks: evaluate the framework on test tasks and aggregate metrics across task IDs
log_scalars_and_memory: log scalar metrics and memory size to the logger at each training stage
